note: Corps of Engineers campground on Rough River Lake. The C and D loops fill a low open point where several south-shore sites sit a few steps from the water at summer pool; the B loop sits higher on a wooded bluff, and the A loop is back from the lake. Boat ramp, beach, playground and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
